TRAFFIC ADVISORY 

12 NOVEMBER 2025

N1 SOUTH CLOSURE AFTER THE MARAISBURG EXIT 

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) issues an urgent traffic advisory regarding a major incident on the N1 South highway.

A tanker crash has occurred on the N1 South after the Maraisburg exit. The tanker is understood to be loaded with paraffin, and diesel is currently leaking from the vehicle.

All lanes on the N1 South after Albertina Sisulu Road are currently closed off. Traffic is being diverted at Albertina Sisulu Road.

Law enforcement officials are on the scene, and emergency services are en route to manage the situation and clear the area.

Motorists should expect heavy delays on the N1 South and on alternative routes as traffic diverts.

All road users are urged to exercise extreme patience. Please use alternative routes such as Gordon Road or Ontdekkers Road to avoid the area.

ENDS 

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit ##SaferJoburg #NomakanjaniManjeNamhlanje #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic

data.raw_text:
🇹🇼 TYPHOON FUNG-WONG BATTERS TAIWAN WITH RECORD FLOODS

The fishing town of Suao was hit hardest, soaking up 648 mm of rain in a single day, flooding over 1,000 homes and injuring 51 people. 

Soldiers waded through muddy streets rescuing stranded residents as locals tried to clear their homes of thick mud.

Forecasters say the storm’s late-season arrival shows how Taiwan’s summers are stretching longer, a trend they warn could be tied to climate change.

Fung-wong is now weakening after killing 27 in the Philippines and is expected to move back into the Pacific.

Source: Reuters

🇹🇼 At least 51 people have been injured in Taiwan as Typhoon Fung-Wong sweeps across the island.

Authorities evacuated more than 8,300 residents from coastal and mountain areas and closed schools as the tropical storm reached Taiwan’s southern regions.

Earlier, Fung-Wong hit the Philippines as a super typhoon, causing floods, landslides, and killing at least 27 people. The storm has since weakened but continues to bring heavy rain and flooding.

The worst-affected area is Hualien County, where floodwaters swept away a car, and rivers have already overflowed their banks.
